hooks.line: I'm 71, and I take the stairs faster than women half my age. Last Sunday, my daughter walked behind me the whole way up and said, "Mama, when did that happen?"

concepts.frame1: Low three-quarter from the sidewalk: N in her Sunday hat and dress already four steps up the brick church steps, passing two women in their 30s who have stopped halfway to catch their breath; her daughter two steps behind her
concepts.stakes: a 71-year-old leaving women half her age behind, in front of the whole congregation
concepts.where: the church front steps on Sunday morning (P5-CHURCH, confirmed)
concepts.turn: 'Last Sunday' lands on the place it shows; the daughter is already in frame behind her for 'walked behind me'

concepts.frame1: Ground level on a stadium's concrete stairs: N climbing to her seat in a team jersey, two younger women stopped with hands on their knees beside her
concepts.stakes: a game-day crowd watching a 71-year-old outpace them
concepts.where: football stadium aisle stairs on game day
concepts.turn: 'Sunday' as game day; the daughter carrying the drinks behind her

concepts.frame1: Behind and above on a subway station stairway at rush hour: N climbing steadily up the right side while younger commuters slow and bunch up on the left
concepts.where: city subway stairs at rush hour
concepts.turn: the daughter appears behind her as the crowd thins

concepts.frame1: Parking-garage stairwell: two younger women waiting by the elevator; N walks past them and takes the stairs
concepts.stakes: choosing the stairs when she could ride
concepts.turn: cut to her on the third landing, the daughter puffing behind

concepts.frame1: Extreme close at step level: her Sunday heels climbing past a pair of sneakers that have stopped on the step
concepts.stakes: age against youth told by the feet alone
concepts.turn: tilt up to her face as the daughter's line comes
